candidate:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u2
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing) -> u1
(u0, at_exit & !siren_ringing) -> u2
(u0, else) -> u0
(u1, switch_toggled & !siren_ringing) -> u0
(u1, else) -> u1
(u2, else) -> u2
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u1, switch_toggled & !siren_ringing, u0) -> 0.1
(u0, at_exit & !siren_ringing, u2) -> 1.0
feedback: Format is compliant: the REWARD_MACHINE header, STATES, INITIAL_STATE, and a nonempty FINAL_STATES (u2) are all present, u2 is declared and accepting, and every transition and reward entry references declared states with the (state, event) -> state and (state, event, next_state) -> reward shapes. All three states carry an else self-loop, so irrelevant events (movement, box_fell, holding_box, box drops, toggles of a silent switch) are absorbed without spurious transitions or rewards, and only the five supplied propositions are used. Semantics are faithful to the task: u1 tracks an active ring; the persistent condition siren_ringing alone moves u0->u1 with no reward, which is correct since the onset is autonomous; the event/persistent guard switch_toggled & !siren_ringing (propositions read after the step) fires exactly on a successful silencing toggle and returns to u0 with +0.1, which is the only regression the task needs and it is explicit; at_exit (last-step-only) & !siren_ringing terminates in u2 with +1.0. Exiting while the siren still rings stays in u1 with reward 0, matching the task clause whenever the siren rings, turn it off and the siren_silent payment condition. Edge cases check out: if a due second start fires on a toggle step, the ring applies after the action so siren_ringing is true at the end of the step, the u1 guard correctly fails, and no reward is paid; toggling a silent siren in u0 falls to the else loop and never rewards, so the 0.1 cannot be farmed; the siren starts at most twice, so intermediate reward is capped at 0.2 and the total at 1.2 (bounded); the u0 ordering with siren_ringing listed before the exit guard is conflict-free because a ring cannot coincide with the episode-ending exit step and an already-ringing siren would have moved the machine to u1 on an earlier step. Minor, non-blocking notes: zero-reward transitions are implicit, which is standard; and the flat 1.0 exit reward does not mirror the environment's time-scaled payment, which is acceptable for a reward machine that defines the task itself.

feedback: All five environment-declared propositions are implemented exactly, with no extras and no missing functions, including holding_box and box_fell, which are declared but unused by this reward machine and therefore required. siren_ringing reads env.siren_ringing directly as a persistent condition; holding_box checks env.carrying is not None and env.carrying.type == "box" with a proper None guard; at_exit reads the agent's own cell and guards empty cells with `is not None` before reading .type, matching the documented expression. The event propositions switch_toggled and box_fell read "toggle"/"fall" membership in env.events_this_step, which is the documented per-step event list, and correctly do not depend on the previous valuation. Everything is pure: no imports, no actions, no mutation of the environment, episode memory, or previous_valuation, and the code is syntactically valid Python returning booleans. Truth conditions match the code notes for all five predicates.
